title: Activity-Based-Lesson Learn-Reflection (ALLR) Assisted by HTML5 Package (H5P) to Develop Critical Thinking Skills of Future Science Teachers
reason: One-group pre/post test of critical-thinking skill after an H5P-supported model on a Moodle LMS. No platform-recorded indicator or activity product is related to any outcome; the 'effect size' is a pre-post score correlation.
